Helicopter gunner aim sway now scales with movement speed when aiming held weapons from the passenger seat.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Vehicles
- Suspension, steering and grip have been tweaked; burnout/launch attempts removed; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock during handbrake.
- Helicopter gunner aim sway now scales with movement speed when aiming held weapons from the passenger seat.

### Animals & NPCs
- Livestock now have a water need and will drink from nearby water containers, rivers, or lakes.

### Tool Cupboard & Upkeep
- Tool cupboard upkeep now scales with authorized players: first 4 add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, any beyond add 4% each.

### General Gameplay
- Repair bench functionality restored.
